documents.text: React useState retains a component value between renders. Call the setter to request a render. State updates should preserve immutability.
React useEffect synchronizes components with external systems. Return cleanup to unsubscribe from an event listener. List reactive values in the dependency array.
React hooks must be called at the top level, not inside loops or conditional branches. Custom hooks share reusable stateful logic.
Install dependencies by running npm install in the project folder. package-lock.json records the resolved dependency tree. Run npm run build to build the project.
This tutorial requires Node.js version 22. Check the installed version with node --version. A different project may require another runtime version.
git commit creates a snapshot. git log displays commit history. A Git tag names a commit, while a branch reference moves as commits are added.
git push sends local commits to a remote repository. git pull integrates remote updates. Do not force push a shared branch without coordinating.
python -m venv .venv creates an isolated Python virtual environment. Activate the environment before installing project packages with pip.
Python pandas DataFrame stores tabular data. read_csv loads a CSV file. Missing values can be examined with isna before cleaning the table.
A SQL index can accelerate selective lookup, but it costs storage and write work. Use EXPLAIN to inspect a query plan before adding an index.
An INNER JOIN keeps matching rows. A LEFT JOIN preserves rows from the left table and fills unmatched right-side values with NULL.
docker build -t demo . builds an image using the Dockerfile in the current directory. docker run starts a container from an image.
docker compose up starts the services defined in a compose file. Named volumes persist container data. Explicitly configure service environment variables.
TypeScript discriminated unions use a common literal tag to narrow the type of a value. A switch on the tag helps check every variant.
Use try catch around awaited promises to handle asynchronous errors. Promise.all rejects when one input rejects. Promise.allSettled records both success and failure outcomes.
HTTP status 429 signals rate limiting. Respect Retry-After when provided. Retrying authentication failures without changing credentials does not solve them.
IndexedDB readwrite transactions commit together. Indexes avoid scanning every record for a key lookup. A database version upgrade can create a new index.
Sanitize untrusted HTML before rendering. Do not expose API keys to webpage scripts. Validate extension message origins and response schemas.
Web Workers run CPU work away from the page thread. Transfer large ArrayBuffers when appropriate. Bound pending work to avoid an unbounded queue.
A regression test reproduces an important failure. An integration test checks interacting components. A mock isolates a dependency but does not measure that dependency's real quality.
